notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
xfreerdp connects to Windows RDP from Linux. /cert:ignore bypasses self-signed certificate warnings (common in internal environments). Full desktop session enables GUI-based enumeration and tool execution.

=== CHAINING ===
Discover RDP open (nmap-rdp-scan) → obtain credentials → xfreerdp connect → GUI desktop → run tools interactively → /drive flag for file transfer (mounts local dir as network share).

=== NLA DETECTION ===
If NLA required: xfreerdp will prompt for credentials before desktop loads. Without NLA: desktop loads immediately, credentials entered on the Windows login screen (legacy security layer).

=== DRIVE MOUNT ===
xfreerdp /v:TARGET /u:user /p:pass /drive:share,/tmp/tools → mounts /tmp/tools as a shared drive in the RDP session → drag-and-drop file transfer without HTTP/SMB server setup.
